int edmondsKarp() {
    vector<int> par(S+1, -1);
    par[0] = 0;
    queue<int> q;
    q.push(0);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int u = q.front(); q.pop();

                q.push(v);

        }
    }
    if (par[S] == -1) return 0;
    int add = 10000;
    for (int v = S; v != 0; v = par[v]) add = min(add, f[par[v]][v]);
    for (int v = S; v != 0; v = par[v]) {
        f[par[v]][v] -= add;
        f[v][par[v]] += add;
    }
    return add;
}

                if (srcCap[i][j] == 0) continue;
                queue<pair<int,pair<int,int>>> q;
                q.push({0,{i,j}});
                vector<vector<bool>> vis(n, vector<bool>(n, false));
                vis[i][j] = true;
                int src = srcId[i][j];
                while (!q.empty()) {
                    auto cur = q.front(); q.pop();
                    int tm = cur.first;
                    int r = cur.second.first;
                    int c = cur.second.second;
                    if (snkCap[r][c] != 0) F[src][snkId[r][c]] = 10000;
                    if (tm == T) continue;
                    if (plant[r][c][tm] != 0) continue;
                    for (int k=0; k<4; ++k) {
                        int nr = r+dr[k], nc = c+dc[k];
                        if (valid(nr,nc) && plant[nr][nc][tm]==0 && !vis[nr][nc]) {
                            vis[nr][nc] = true;
                            q.push({tm+1,{nr,nc}});
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    void addBoundaryEdges() {
        for (int i=0; i<n; ++i) {
            for (int j=0; j<n; ++j) {
                if (srcCap[i][j] != 0) F[0][srcId[i][j]] = srcCap[i][j];
                if (snkCap[i][j] != 0) F[snkId[i][j]][sinkNode] = snkCap[i][j];
            }
        }
    }

public:
    Solver() {
        memset(F, 0, sizeof(F));
    }

    void run() {
        cin >> n >> T;
        vector<string> s(n);
        for (int i=0; i<n; ++i) cin >> s[i];

        for (int i=0; i<n; ++i)
            for (int j=0; j<n; ++j)
                if (s[i][j]=='Y' || s[i][j]=='Z') {
                    plant[i][j][0] = s[i][j]-'X';
                    srcCap[i][j] = 0;
                } else {
                    plant[i][j][0] = 0;
                    srcCap[i][j] = s[i][j]-'0';
                }

        for (int i=0; i<n; ++i) cin >> s[i];

        for (int i=0; i<n; ++i)
            for (int j=0; j<n; ++j)
                if (s[i][j]=='Y' || s[i][j]=='Z') {
                    plant[i][j][0] = s[i][j]-'X';
                    snkCap[i][j] = 0;
                } else {
                    plant[i][j][0] = 0;
                    snkCap[i][j] = s[i][j]-'0';
                }

        simulatePlants();

        sinkNode = 1;
        memset(srcId, -1, sizeof(srcId));
        memset(snkId, -1, sizeof(snkId));
        for (int i=0; i<n; ++i)
            for (int j=0; j<n; ++j)
                if (srcCap[i][j] != 0) srcId[i][j] = sinkNode++;
        for (int i=0; i<n; ++i)
            for (int j=0; j<n; ++j)
                if (snkCap[i][j] != 0) snkId[i][j] = sinkNode++;

        addReachabilityEdges();
        addBoundaryEdges();

        int ans = 0;
        while (true) {
            int f = findPath();
            if (!f) break;
            ans += f;
        }
        cout << ans << '\n';
    }
};

const int Solver::dr[4] = {0,0,-1,1};
const int Solver::dc[4] = {-1,1,0,0};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    Solver solver;
    solver.run();
    return 0;
}
